Rough Iron 3 Inch Offset Cabinet Hinges

text.description_html:
Acorn RH4BQ, Rough Iron 3 Inch H-L Offset Cabinet Hinges

For over a half a century, authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home. The Iron H-L Cabinet Hinges are forged with this in mind. The rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered iron. It has a lifetime no rust warranty. The Acorn 3" H-L Hinge has a 3/8" offset.

Also Available: Flush 3" Rough Iron H-L Cabinet Hinges

Specifications of Acorn Rough Iron 3" HL Hinge:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Height: 3"
  • Width: 1-7/16"
  • 3/8" Offset Hinge: Door face sits 3/8" out from the door frame.

Priced and sold as a pair (2-hinges)



** This item is discontinued. See available Acorn Iron Cabinet Hinges
